description: This file contains integration tests for Fixed Deposit functionality within the Apache Fineract project. It includes tests for interest calculation, product creation, account lifecycle events (apply, approve, activate, mature, preclose), interest posting, and handling of different account closing closure types, with specific focus on scenarios involving cash-based accounting and tax withholding.

methods.name: setup
methods.description: Initialize test environment, including RESTAssured setup, request/response specifications, and helper class instances.

methods.name: testFixedDepositInterestCalculationWithWrongCompoundingPeriod
methods.description: Test interest calculation method throws validation error with invalid compounding period.

methods.name: testFixedDepositInterestCalculationWithWrongCompoundingPeriod2
methods.description: Another test for interest calculation validation with different invalid compounding period.

methods.name: testFixedDepositInterestCalculationWithValidInput
methods.description: Test interest calculation returns expected maturity amount with valid input.

methods.name: testFixedDepositProductCreation
methods.description: Test creating fixed deposit products with and without charts, verifying success and failure cases.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeWithdrawal
methods.description: Simulate a full lifecycle of a fixed deposit account with premature withdrawal closure, validating journal entries and account states.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeWithdrawal_WITH_HOLD_TAX
methods.description: Test early withdrawal with tax withholding, validating journal entries and withholding handling.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountClosureTypeWithdrawal_WITH_HOLD_TAX
methods.description: Full test of premature closure with tax withholding and account balance validation.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountWithPrematureClosureTypeReinvest
methods.description: Test premature closure with reinvestment, validating error handling and journal entries.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountUpdation
methods.description: Test updating an existing fixed deposit account details.

methods.name: testFixedDepositAccountUndoApproval
methods.description: Test undoing an approval on a fixed deposit account.

methods.description: Test account with amount interest rate chart with period variation.
